## Changed
- **Melon planters yield 4 slices per harvest, up from 1.** A single slice per cycle made melon the least valuable crop in the mod (below potato); 4 slices brings it to per-plant parity with a hand-built vanilla melon farm and a fair mid-tier on the villager-trade economy (~⅔ of a pumpkin's value). Pumpkin and every other crop are unchanged.
